name: 金庸群侠传
english_description: A sibling archive to this project's jyqxc (numbers 086/087) carrying the same "Story of Hero" content: the same compact Jin Yong sect map (Mount Hua, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, Emei, the Ming Cult), including White Camel Manor's overpowered young master Ouyang Ke roaming the streets and the Ghost Gate Pass death sequence with its uncommon third psychopomp NPC. A file-by-file diff confirmed the two are, in essence, two near-complete snapshots of the same original data rather than independently developed variants sharing only the same architecture — of roughly 3,690 files in each "work" tree, only a handful differ (a not-yet-patched login script, two runtime logs, and each one's leftover test character), while the death system and other core files are byte-for-byte identical. The archive filenames even show the classic browser double-download pattern, suggesting both came from the same original download that this project's deduplication process didn't catch.
